properties.description: **Enterprise** — Zero-trust and regulatory alignment for Container Registry: controls that require infrastructure investment or map directly to compliance frameworks. This tier delivers customer-managed keys (CMK / BYOK) for cryptographic sovereignty and direct mapping to regulatory framework controls. Together these policies protect against lateral movement, sovereign-data exfiltration, and audit gaps in regulated workloads.
